svg.title: A36: transient IL-10 exposure and later neuronal output
svg.desc: Qualitative proposed comparison. Early progenitor response and later surviving birthdated neuronal output are distinct. No measured effect or lineage transition is depicted.
svg.text: A36 · Does transient D25K improve later neuronal output?
Aged SVZ–olfactory-bulb lineage · direct D25K versus WT IL-10 and vehicle
Working prediction: a later surviving birthdated neuronal advantage that early progenitor abundance
alone does not adequately describe. Similar output, early-only effects and direct neural effects remain possible.
Arrows show proposed decisions, not demonstrated biological transitions or mediation.
Later D25K advantage → bounded output benefit; similar gains → common ligand response.
Early-only increase → persistence / maturation / duration question; mixed results remain unresolved.
Representation and within-bin differences can coexist; neither is a tissue census or purified NSC effect.
Unknown: exact exposure, later interval, biological-unit variance, meaningful effect and sample size.
RNA ≠ fate / secretion / survival. Age modification needs matched treatment contrasts at both ages.
Qualitative v1 · 10 November 2026 · No measured counts, scientific acceptance or laboratory readiness.
